text: Amazon says it will invest more than €16 billion (about $18 billion) in Germany in 2027. That includes €4.8 billion to expand its Frankfurt AWS region and AI infrastructure. The package also covers Amazon Leo satellite internet, logistics sites and Prime Video shows.
